entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Jitendra Ojha
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Javed Gauri, PP assisted by  Mr. Avinash Godara  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 18/08/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.19/2023, Police Station Chitri, District Dungarpur for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 376 & 354(D) of the IPC and Section 67-A of IT Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that according to statement of prosecutrix under Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as Court statement, she admits that she was having an affair with the petitioner and she herself went in a hotel with him where the accused committed rape with her.
Counsel further submits that prosecutrix was a major and if anything happened, that was with the consent of the prosecutrix.
The petitioner is in the judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
[2023:RJ-JD:26111] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-6798/2023] Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused- petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

Pankaj vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:26111) on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42786028/
1
Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner, Pankaj S/o Soma, shall be enlarged on bail in FIR No.19/2023, Police Station Chitri, District Dungarpur provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
